caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane composed of several elements arranged vertically. At the top is a golden-brown eagle with detailed feathers, wings partly raised, and head facing to the left. The eagle stands on a gold spherical ornament, which is mounted on a horizontal arrow. The arrow has a pointed tip on the left side and a large, feathered fletching on the right composed of textured golden-brown elements. Below the arrow are two stacked gold spherical ornaments, decreasing in size as they go up. At the bottom, a cross-shaped directional indicator, painted in black or dark gray, points to the four cardinal directions with large block letters: "N," "S," "E," and "W." The drawing is outlined by a thin red border, and a smaller inset illustration appears in the top right corner, showing a simplified version of the weather vane with red line work. The sheet has some minor staining and a cream background, with a handwritten notation and signature in the lower right corner.
title: Eagle Weather Vane
